activate.description: Bring Preview to the foreground without opening, importing, or selecting a document.

activate-direct.description: Foreground Preview without selecting or opening a document.

prohibited: claiming recipient receipt or exact file opening from host callback or launch acceptance
editing, annotating, signing, sharing, moving, or deleting a document
safety.uncertain_outcome: A launch or transfer may already have occurred. Do not replay; inspect with the user.

data_access: No document content is read by the integration
data_sent: A user-selected local file is offered through macOS AirDrop only for drop/show
privacy.retention: The repository retains no document content. The AirDrop transport may retain a private snapshot only after uncertain delivery.
privacy.notes: Launch proof is exact-profile. AirDrop callback completion does not prove receipt or exact opening.
